scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @cadastro/contratos && concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @cadastro/contratos && npm run build --workspace @cadastro/api && npm run build --workspace @cadastro/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @cadastro/contratos && npm run test --workspace @cadastro/api && npm run test:e2e --workspace @cadastro/api && npm run test --workspace @cadastro/web
scripts.test:cov: npm run test:cov --workspace @cadastro/contratos && npm run test:cov --workspace @cadastro/api && npm run test:cov --workspace @cadastro/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @cadastro/contratos && npm run typecheck --workspace @cadastro/contratos && npm run typecheck --workspace @cadastro/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @cadastro/web
